tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria is noted. Glucosuria is present without ketones. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy; further evaluation for possible underlying causes of glucosuria is advised.
